title.en: Printed-row question: Which compact pumps print weights under 500 kg
title.zh: 先看已印出的行：哪些紧凑泵的重量印在 500 kg 以下

h1.en: Printed-row question: Which compact pumps print weights under 500 kg
h1.zh: 先看已印出的行：哪些紧凑泵的重量印在 500 kg 以下

description.en: Three electric compact rows from Xingtai-based Hebei Pinjin Machinery: B500S-83D at 280 kg, Electric 10 Series at 400 kg and Electric 15 at 450 kg. Weight does not replace the distance cell. B500S-83D is 5 m / 5 m. Electric 10 Series is 25 m horizontal and has no vertical cell. Electric 15 is 15–20 m vertical and 60–80 m horizontal.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械（邢台）的三行电动紧凑机：B500S-83D 280 kg，电动10系列 400 kg，电动15 450 kg。重量不能代替距离格。B500S-83D 是 5 m / 5 m。电动10系列是水平 25 m，没有垂直格。电动15是垂直 15–20 m、水平 60–80 m。

directAnswer.en: Three electric compact rows from Xingtai-based Hebei Pinjin Machinery: B500S-83D at 280 kg, Electric 10 Series at 400 kg and Electric 15 at 450 kg. Weight does not replace the distance cell. B500S-83D is 5 m / 5 m. Electric 10 Series is 25 m horizontal and has no vertical cell. Electric 15 is 15–20 m vertical and 60–80 m horizontal.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械（邢台）的三行电动紧凑机：B500S-83D 280 kg，电动10系列 400 kg，电动15 450 kg。重量不能代替距离格。B500S-83D 是 5 m / 5 m。电动10系列是水平 25 m，没有垂直格。电动15是垂直 15–20 m、水平 60–80 m。

body.en: “Pre-tensioned concrete” is an outline label from “Prestressed concrete”. That label does not add a figure to the printed row. Three electric compact rows from Xingtai-based Hebei Pinjin Machinery: B500S-83D at 280 kg, Electric 10 Series at 400 kg and Electric 15 at 450 kg. The 800 kg rural diesel and the 1300 kg 4100 are the off-grid compact pair, already above 500 kg. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prestressed_concrete
body.zh: “先张混凝土”是《Prestressed concrete》大纲上的标题。这个标题不给已印出的行增加数字。河北品锦机械（邢台）的三行电动紧凑机：B500S-83D 280 kg，电动10系列 400 kg，电动15 450 kg。800 kg 的农村柴油泵和 1300 kg 的 4100 是无电网紧凑一对，已经超过 500 kg。图来自来源页面：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prestressed_concrete

body.en: “Post-tensioned concrete” is an outline label from “Prestressed concrete”. That label does not add a figure to the printed row. Weight does not replace the distance cell. B500S-83D is 5 m / 5 m. Electric 15 is 15–20 m vertical and 60–80 m horizontal. Is Electric 20 under 500 kg? No. Electric 20 prints 900 kg.
body.zh: “后张混凝土”是《Prestressed concrete》大纲上的标题。这个标题不给已印出的行增加数字。重量不能代替距离格。B500S-83D 是 5 m / 5 m。电动15是垂直 15–20 m、水平 60–80 m。电动20低于 500 kg 吗？不是。电动20印的是 900 kg。

body.en: “Tendon durability and corrosion protection” is an outline label from “Prestressed concrete”. That label does not add a figure to the printed row. Are sprayer weights in this list? No. This list is pumps. Type 311 at 150 kg and M9 at 200 kg are spraying machines.
body.zh: “筋束耐久与防腐蚀”是《Prestressed concrete》大纲上的标题。这个标题不给已印出的行增加数字。喷涂机重量在这份名单里吗？不在。这份名单是泵。150 kg 的 311 和 200 kg 的 M9 是喷涂机。

body.en: “Applications” is an outline label from “Prestressed concrete”. That label does not add a figure to the printed row. Electric 10 Series is 25 m horizontal and has no vertical cell. Does 400 kg mean Electric 10 Series reaches as far as Electric 15? No. Electric 10 Series prints 25 m horizontal. Electric 15 prints 60–80 m horizontal.
body.zh: “用途”是《Prestressed concrete》大纲上的标题。这个标题不给已印出的行增加数字。电动10系列是水平 25 m，没有垂直格。400 kg 表示电动10系列和电动15一样远吗？不是。电动10系列印水平 25 m。电动15印水平 60–80 m。

body.en: “Design agencies and regulations” is an outline label from “Prestressed concrete”. That label does not add a figure to the printed row. B500S-83D is 915 × 550 × 550 mm. Electric 10 Series is 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm. Electric 15 is 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm. All three need electricity: 380 V on B500S-83D, and 15 kW motors on Electric 10 Series. A narrow plot that fits 550 mm width may not fit the 900 mm Electric 15 frame. Reach Xingtai at /contact, the site WhatsApp, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025.
body.zh: “设计机构与法规”是《Prestressed concrete》大纲上的标题。这个标题不给已印出的行增加数字。B500S-83D 是 915 × 550 × 550 mm。电动10系列是 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm。电动15是 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm。三台都要电：B500S-83D 为 380 V，电动10系列电机为 15 kW。放得下 550 mm 宽的窄场地，不一定放得下电动15的 900 mm 机架。联系邢台可用 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。

question.en: Is Electric 20 under 500 kg, under the outline “Pre-tensioned concrete”?
question.zh: 在“先张混凝土”这一节里，电动20低于 500 kg 吗？

question.en: Does 400 kg mean Electric 10 Series reaches as far as Electric 15, under the outline “Post-tensioned concrete”?
question.zh: 在“后张混凝土”这一节里，400 kg 表示电动10系列和电动15一样远吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 10 Series prints 25 m horizontal. Electric 15 prints 60–80 m horizontal.
answer.zh: 不是。电动10系列印水平 25 m。电动15印水平 60–80 m。

question.en: Are sprayer weights in this list, under the outline “Tendon durability and corrosion protection”?
question.zh: 在“筋束耐久与防腐蚀”这一节里，喷涂机重量在这份名单里吗？

answer.en: No. This list is pumps. Type 311 at 150 kg and M9 at 200 kg are spraying machines.
answer.zh: 不在。这份名单是泵。150 kg 的 311 和 200 kg 的 M9 是喷涂机。
